name: Gold Coast Quarry
summary: In southwestern Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood holds Gold Coast Quarry and draws on its remaining riches for rebellion. Once, its stone, minerals, and gold helped rebuild Stormwind.

sections.title: A Plundered Resource
sections.body: Stormwind once drew stone and gold from Gold Coast Quarry to rebuild the kingdom. After royal troops left Westfall, Defias highwaymen and renegade laborers seized the mine. Now Brotherhood patrols watch from its terraced ramps above the coast and take the minerals still left there to fund their rebellion.

faq.q: What was the quarry originally used for?
aliases: why is there a quarry here
faq.answer: Stormwind opened Gold Coast Quarry for stone, minerals, and gold. Stone from quarries across Westfall helped rebuild the city after the Second War.

faq.q: Who controls the Gold Coast Quarry right now?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood controls Gold Coast Quarry. Its brigands, looters, and highwaymen patrol the terraced cliffs and mine entrances, keeping settlers away while they take resources for their own operations.

faq.q: Why hasn't Stormwind sent guards to clear the quarry?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing, the Stormwind House of Nobles will not fund a standing garrison in Westfall. The crown has abandoned the region, leaving the People's Militia to fight for control of places like the quarry alone.

faq.q: Where is the Gold Coast Quarry located?
aliases: how to find gold coast quarry
faq.answer: Gold Coast Quarry cuts into the cliffs of southwestern Westfall, south of the Saldean and Alexston farmsteads, above the Great Sea.

angles.text: As a miner in Westfall, you can find rich stone faces and mineral veins along the quarry cliffs. Working them means fighting through entrenched Defias patrols.
As an Alliance member, you know that reclaiming sites like Gold Coast Quarry is vital to restoring order in Westfall. With no royal garrisons, local volunteers have taken up arms.
